reason: I already sell on Chariow and payment confirmation there is automatic; here I have to watch my SasPay and tap to confirm each sale myself, which is the same WhatsApp back-and-forth I want to escape. With only a few sales a month the commission I would save does not justify moving, and 4 900 FCFA a month is a lot from my income.
objection: Another new platform I have never heard of: who is behind Maketia, and will it still exist in six months with my pages and my customers' links on it?
would_change_my_mind: Automatic confirmation of SasPay payments, plus creators I know in Abidjan or Dakar showing their real sales on it.
